Name: Adjustable Starting Money
Author: VetoCV
Description:
[left]This mod lets you configure how much money you start with on a new farm. This can be used to configure the starting amount below that of vanilla for a harder start, or it can be set above that of vanilla for an accelerated start.[/left]
[heading][left][u]Features[/u][/left]
[/heading]
[left][list]
[*]Set your starting money to any non-negative value[/*]
[*]Defaults to 500g (vanilla behavior)[/*]
[*]Optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] support[/*]
[*]Console commands for quick adjustments[/*]
[*]Only applies on Spring 1 Year 1 of a new save; existing saves are unaffected[/*]
[/list][heading][u]Installation[/u][/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*]Download the mod and extract the AdjustableStartingMoney folder into your Mods folder[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI[/*]
[/list][heading][u]Configuration[/u][/heading]
[list]
[*]StartingMoney - The amount of gold you start with on a new save. Default is 500, same as vanilla. Must be 0 or a positive integer.[/*]
[/list][heading][u]Console Commands[/u][/heading]
[list]
[*]asm_show - Displays the current configured starting money amount[/*]
[*]asm_set - Sets the starting money to the specified amount[/*]
[/list][heading][u]Notes & FAQS:[/u][/heading]
[list]
[*]Starting money applies on save load when it is Spring 1 Year 1. If you start a new save, quit without saving, and reload, the configured amount will be applied again on reload.[/*]
[*]The save file selection screen will always show 500g for a new save before it is first loaded. The correct amount is applied once the save loads.[/*]
[*]Total Earnings is reset to 0 on a new save. This is intentional as starting money is not considered earned income.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer: Only the host's starting money is adjusted. Farmhand starting money is not modified by this mod. This mod does not explicitly support multiplayer at this time, but I am open to exploring it in the future.[/*]
[*]No known incompatibilities at this time, but let me know if you find any![/*]
[/list]
